import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 7

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture7

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 7](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph $G$,
$L_s(G) \ge \max_v \lambda(v) - 1 + n - 2 \alpha(G)$,
where $L_s(G)$ is the maximum number of leaves over all spanning trees of $G$,
$n = |V(G)|$, $\alpha(G) = G.\mathrm{indepNum}$ is the independence number, and
$\lambda(v) = \mathrm{indepNeighborsCard}\, G\, v$ is the independence number of the
neighbourhood of $v$.

Proved by DeLaVina, Fajtlowicz, Waller (2002).
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture7 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let maxL := (Finset.univ.image (fun v => indepNeighborsCard G v)).max' (by simp)
    ((maxL : ℤ) - 1 + (Fintype.card α : ℤ) - 2 * (G.indepNum : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ Ls G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The independence number is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ G.indepNum := Nat.zero_le _

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture7

reformulations.difference: Lean assumes Nontrivial α, whereas the source states the inequality for finite simple connected graphs without explicitly excluding the one-vertex graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Connectedness already excludes the empty graph. The only additional omitted case is the one-vertex graph, where the maximum local independence number is 0, n = 1, the independence number is 1, and Ls = 0. Its inequality is therefore −2 ≤ 0. Consequently the assertions over nontrivial connected graphs and over all nonempty connected graphs are equivalent. The equivalence is proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean as Review.bound_nontrivial_iff_nonempty, without using the conjecture or any sorry-dependent result.

sources_consulted: https://web.archive.org/web/20240726225301/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowii/wowIIdefs.js — invariant definitions 1, 3, 4, 5 and reference for Conjecture 7.

E. DeLaVina, S. Fajtlowicz and B. Waller, On Some Conjectures of Griggs and Graffiti, March 2002, revised May 2003: introduction, Conjecture 2, and its proof in Section 2. https://web.archive.org/web/20231117053853/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/GPC/griggsngraffiti.pdf

Local definitions: FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Independence.lean and SpanningTree.lean; Mathlib's SimpleGraph Basic, Clique, Subgraph, Finite, Acyclic, and Connectivity/Connected modules; Finset/Max and the real-supremum API.
review.notes: Both the conjecture theorem and the anonymous nonnegativity test were checked. The source's definitions and inequality match the Lean statement, and its attribution to DeLaVina–Fajtlowicz–Waller (2002) supports the research solved category. Scratch Lean checks confirmed that subtraction occurs in ℝ without natural-number truncation, the finite-image maximum is genuine, and Ls is attained by an actual spanning tree for every connected finite graph. Additional checks proved Ls(K₂) = 2 and the empty/singleton boundary values, and evaluated the independence quantities on complete graphs, a cycle, and a star. The final scratch file compiles successfully; the substantive verification lemmas have no sorryAx dependency. Archived sources were used because the live cited host was unavailable.
